---
applyTo: "docs/**"
---

Prose under `docs/` follows `docs/STYLE.md`. Flag em dashes and en dashes, hedge
adverbs, first person outside a confessed limit, recaps and calls to action,
and claims that rest on best practice rather than a named artifact or number.

A change to how the stack is deployed starts with the ADR in `docs/decisions/`
that owns the subject. Flag a design doc or architecture change that
contradicts an accepted ADR without amending or superseding it. New ADRs use
`docs/decisions/adr-template.md` and the next free number.
